title: Learn the Effects, Not the Examples: Implicit ICL via Attention Patching
abstract: arXiv:2611.30690v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables language models to adapt to new tasks from demonstrations, but repeatedly including multiple examples increases context length and inference cost. Many existing implicit ICL methods encode demonstrations as fixed vectors, limiting adaptation of the intervention to individual queries and token positions. We propose Attention-Patching, an implicit ICL method that models contextual changes in self-attention outputs through task-specific updates to attention output projections. Using query-answer pairs processed with and without a fixed demonstration set, Attention-Patching fits layer-wise affine transformations from non-contextual attention representations to the demonstration-induced output changes. Across 12 classification benchmarks and four model families, Attention-Patching achieves higher average accuracy than the evaluated implicit ICL baselines while maintaining performance comparable to explicit IC

translated_title: 学习效果而非示例：通过注意力修补实现隐式上下文学习
translated_abstract: 上下文学习（ICL）使语言模型能够通过示例适应新任务，但重复包含多个示例会增加上下文长度和推理成本。许多现有的隐式ICL方法将示例编码为固定向量，限制了干预对单个查询和标记位置的适应性。我们提出了Attention-Patching，这是一种隐式ICL方法，通过对注意力输出投影进行任务特定的更新来建模自注意力输出中的上下文变化。利用在有无固定示例集两种情况下处理的查询-答案对，Attention-Patching拟合从非上下文注意力表示到示例诱导的输出变化之间的逐层仿射变换。在12个分类基准和四个模型家族上的实验表明，Attention-Patching相比所评估的隐式ICL基线方法取得了更高的平均准确率，同时保持了与显式ICL相当的性能。
tldr: 提出Attention-Patching方法，通过学习逐层仿射变换来模拟示例对注意力输出的影响，无需在上下文中包含示例即可实现高效且性能优异的隐式上下文学习。
en_tdlr: Attention-Patching learns layer-wise affine transformations to model the effects of demonstrations on attention outputs, enabling efficient implicit in-context learning without including examples in the context.
